name: My Plugin
description: A WordPress plugin scaffolded with WP Plugin Lab.
author: Lukasz Sobolewski

editions.//: wporg says whether an edition is destined for the WordPress.org directory. Plugin Check only runs on those: a privately distributed add-on legitimately carries an Update URI header and no readme.txt, both of which the directory's own tool reports as errors.

skills.//: Official WordPress agent skills (https://github.com/WordPress/agent-skills, GPL-2.0-or-later). Managed by `./bin/wpx skills`; an empty install list means every skill.

lab.//: Where `./bin/wpx upgrade` pulls the lab infrastructure from. Point it at your own starter repository.
